mentions.name: LemmingsJS-MIDI
mentions.description: An extremely performant JavaScript port of Lemmings, capable of simulating roughly 28,000,000 lemmings at original game speed on a decent PC, with a full MIDI subsystem (planned to become a sequencer), a level editor, and other extras.
